card.name: Linking word after place nouns
card.fires_on: The small linking word (where, of, for, with) right after a place noun such as place, places, spot, point or a named location. It looks ahead to a description of what happens there.

modes.label: where after a place
modes.description: The word where follows a place or location noun and starts a clause describing it.
modes.example: a point in space<< where>> balanced gravitational forces allow an object to remain

modes.label: for, of or with after place
modes.description: A preposition follows place or spot and introduces its purpose or character.
modes.example: Find a sunny spot<< for>> your container.

card.writes: It seems to push toward rare name-like pieces and away from common word endings, which is only a weak output effect.
card.plain: It fires on the little word after "place" or "spot" that leads into what the place is for or where something happens.
evidence: is "the place<< where>> Jesus was crucified.
a secret place<< for>> hiding things
if you live in a place<< with>> an average wind speeds of about 9
